title: Three layouts for cms.brickbot.ro
question: All three keep the Arena Lights look of the website, links and auth: black, exact #FFEC17, Anek Latin, squircle boards. They differ in how you move around and where team activity lives. Each sketch shows the home screen at desktop size; the list → edit pattern is described on the card and gets built in the layout you lock. Lock one, or steer and re-roll.

options.label: Arena Rail
options.lineage: auth's Floodlit Split, carried inside: the arena becomes the sidebar
options.thesis: The floodlit photo from sign-in shrinks into the top of a left rail and stays with you; under it, the modules you're allowed into, grouped Website / Links / Admin. Home is a wall of module boards beside a 'Pit radio' feed of who changed what.
materials: photo band with mark + wordmark at the top of the rail
module boards with count + last editor
options.viewport: Left 280px rail: team photo band with the wordmark, then nav groups, Publish pinned at the bottom with last build status. Main: 'Hey Marius' line, a 3-column grid of module boards (Blog · 2 drafts · Ana, 2h ago). Right 340px: Pit radio, today's changes with names in ink and module names in yellow. Edit pattern: list rows on the desk; opening one swaps to EN | RO twin columns with a sticky Save bar.
options.risk: The most familiar admin layout; the photo band and boards have to carry the brand so it doesn't read as a generic dashboard template.

options.label: Perimeter Board
options.lineage: the website's LED perimeter strip, put to work as the team's live feed
options.thesis: No sidebar: a top bar with Website ▾ Links ▾ Admin ▾ menus, and right under it a full-width LED strip that scrolls the team's latest changes. Home is a big typographic index of modules, every name a one-click door.
materials: large Expanded module index with condensed counts
options.viewport: Top bar: mark + wordmark, three menus, Publish at right. Below: a 54px LED strip, ANA · EDITED · SPONSORS · 12 MIN, names lit yellow. Body: modules set large in three columns by group, each with its count and last change in condensed type; a 'Your recent edits' row at the bottom. Edit pattern: full-width sortable table; a row opens a full-page editor with EN | RO columns and a sticky action bar.
options.risk: Scrolling activity is glanceable but not scannable; the strip needs a 'see all' that opens the full feed, and top menus cost one extra click on deep modules.

options.label: Jump Bar
options.lineage: auth's lit input grown into the CMS's front door
options.thesis: Keyboard first. A slim icon rail on the left, and home opens on one big lit field: 'Jump to…' (⌘K anywhere). Below it, the team's recent changes double as 'pick up where you left off': every row is a link straight into that item.
materials: large command field lit yellow on focus
activity rows that open the item
options.viewport: Left: 64px icon rail with the logo mark on top. Main, centred 880px: 'Jump to a module, post, sponsor…' field with ⌘K hint; a row of module chips; then 'Lately on the team' as a list grouped Today / Yesterday, each row avatar initial · who · what · item · time. Edit pattern: master-detail, a 380px list on the left and the editor on the right, EN | RO side by side.
options.risk: Command palettes are second nature to some members and invisible to others; the chips and icon rail must make it work without ever typing.
